title: Microsoft Copilot in Business Central: What the New Unified Chat Experience Means
summary: Microsoft Copilot's new unified chat experience in Business Central combines internal business data, web search results, and general AI knowledge in a single conversational interface. Available as part of Business Central 2026 release wave 2 public preview, it requires administrator enablement on the Copilot & Agent Capabilities page and represents a shift toward AI-assisted application interaction.
key_points: The unified chat combines three sources: Business Central data, web search results, and general AI knowledge in one interface
Available to all Business Central license holders, with additional benefits for users having Microsoft Copilot licenses
Administrators must enable the feature on the Copilot & Agent Capabilities page once it rolls out to their environment
This reflects Microsoft's broader strategy to align Business Central with the wider Copilot ecosystem and conversational interaction patterns
Implications extend beyond the chat feature itself, affecting how developers design extensions, consultants approach training, and administrators manage governance

quotes.text: After it is available in an environment, administrators may need to enable it on the Copilot & Agent Capabilities page.
quotes.why_it_matters: Critical for administrators implementing the feature, identifying where enablement occurs
